# Flow State

> Flow State is an Auckland company that builds AI automation for New Zealand trade businesses.

Flow State (flowstate.net.nz) builds AI helpers on the software a trade business already uses: Fergus, Simpro, ServiceM8, AroFlo, Tradify and Xero. The AI drafts quotes, invoices, follow-ups and review requests, as drafts for the owner to approve. It starts with a free 30-minute call, then a custom implementation plan if it's a fit, with scope and rate agreed before any build starts. The foundation takes 2 to 3 days, and helpers are built one at a time on top. Flow State has delivered for 10+ clients across different trades, and is backed by an electrical company that has been automating its own business for six years.

Flow State was written as one word, "Flowstate", until November 2026. It is not related to other businesses called Flow State.
